title: Phantom Enemy Wall Reversal Freezes Enemy at Wall
explanation: At frame 1779 (t=30.95s), an enemy colliding with the wall at (5800, 550) triggered continuous enemy_reversed_at_wall events with old_direction 0.0 and new_direction 0.0 across 787 frames. Traced to Enemy.gd:L51-L61 where sign(velocity.x) yields 0.0 on perpendicular wall contact, trapping the enemy in a permanent zero-velocity loop.
